title: Today
goal: A returning student knows what to do next, why it is here and when they can stop.

title: Plans
goal: A student sees which plan needs attention and reaches the actual scheduled activity.

title: Plan calendar
goal: The calendar makes a realistic promise and offers recovery when that promise no longer fits.

title: New plan
goal: A student sets a realistic schedule without losing their place or earlier choices in the existing four-step wizard.

title: AI plan proposal
goal: AI offers an inspectable draft whose saved schedule matches the student’s actual preferences.

title: Library
goal: A student can scan familiar topic names, preview one and start the appropriate study activity.

title: Search
goal: Results identify the thing being found before asking the student to read its explanation.

title: Topic overview
goal: Know the next useful study action before choosing extra resources.

title: Lesson
goal: Compare a small explanation with its visual, then continue without losing your place.

title: 3D Studio
goal: Use the model to answer one observation, with orientation and controls always clear.

title: Exam diagram trainer
goal: Build the existing diagram by placing labels one layer at a time, then draw it on paper from memory.

title: Practice question
goal: Read one question, commit to an answer, then inspect feedback without losing context.

title: Recall
goal: Keep the recall prompt, reveal action and honest self-rating together on the smallest screen.

title: Knee recognition sample
goal: Compare the marked structure and both possible answers in the same compact study view.

title: Welcome to MedLearn
goal: Understand the study loop and enter the app without a long promotional scroll.

title: Set up your plan
goal: Make four understandable choices and reach a useful first study task.

title: Your books
goal: Choose familiar books once, then get relevant reading references in each topic.

title: Your profile
goal: Adjust study preferences without navigating through a second dashboard.

title: Your account
goal: Understand saving, permissions and sign-in without promotional distractions.

title: Offline recovery
goal: Explain what can still be used and offer one safe next step.

title: Content review
goal: Help reviewers find a topic, understand the pending change and record an explicit decision.

title: Review administration
goal: Manage review-team access and trace decisions with a compact utility layout.

title: Facilitator setup
goal: Set up a usability scenario with a clear preview of the data it replaces on this device.
